_why: A property the generated API types DELIBERATELY lose. The guard (scripts/typegen-drop-guard.mjs) refuses any other drop that this repo's sources still read. Each key is a wire property name; each value is the reason it is gone, in a sentence a reader can act on. Empty is the correct state.

allowed_drops.standing: Retired on purpose (aidream migration 0658 'masterwork frequency is not existence'; rationale in aidream/services/distillation/distill.py, which ends 'Nothing reads standing any more. Do not reintroduce it.'). It admitted a distilled rule as mere 'evidence' until it recurred across N pieces, which is consensus collapse with a threshold on it — the opposite of the mandate it was written under. Volume is now handled by sectioning plus the review surface's explicit-selection bulk actions; recurrence is a derived BADGE ('seen in 3 pieces') off source_ref.evidence_pieces, never a gate. The guard's hits in this repo are the English word 'standing' and an unrelated VersionStanding badge, not reads of this wire field.
allowed_drops.grain: Removed on purpose by aidream 1f0b31f8ce (T12): the AI-visibility trend's day/week time series was replaced by named metrics at GET /ai-visibility/panels/{panel_id}/metrics. This repo's PanelTrend is a local type (features/marketing/seo/ai-visibility/panels/service.ts) that never read it; the guard's hits are storage-meter `meter.grain`, a different field.
allowed_drops.points: Removed on purpose by aidream 1f0b31f8ce with the pooled trend series (no pooled rate — six named metrics replace it). No reader of PanelTrend.points exists here; the guard's hits are the English word 'points'.
allowed_drops.headline: Removed on purpose by aidream 1f0b31f8ce ('trends: pooled headline and rates removed'). This repo's panels view already renders no pooled headline; other 'headline' hits are unrelated fields.
allowed_drops.mention_rate: Removed on purpose by aidream 1f0b31f8ce with the pooled rates; nothing here reads it.
allowed_drops.citation_rate: Removed on purpose by aidream 1f0b31f8ce with the pooled rates; nothing here reads it.
allowed_drops.campaign_context: Renamed to `pitch` by aidream 90ea9a2874 (journalist fit check); the server still accepts campaign_context only as an input alias. features/crm/enrichment/service.ts now sends `pitch`; the remaining hit (ChaseboxDraftDialog CLAIM_SOURCE_LABELS) is a claim-source label, not this wire field.
allowed_drops.hard_delete: Delete means archive (Arman, 2026-09-27): the files bulk-delete request lost its hard_delete flag on purpose (aidream 1e5195661c); every files delete is a Trash move.
